title: Visa is buying BioCatch for $2.4 billion because AI scams now cost the global economy $1 trillion a year
excerpt: Visa is acquiring BioCatch for $2.4B in cash. The startup detects fraud by analysing typing cadence and touchscreen pressure. It protects 760 million users across 350 banks.
content_html:
TL;DR

Visa is acquiring BioCatch for $2.4B cash from Permira. BioCatch uses behavioral biometrics to catch fraud before payment. Visa estimates scams cost $1T/year globally. 760M users, 350 banks.

Visa is acquiring Tel Aviv-based fraud detection startup BioCatch for $2.4 billion in cash from private equity firm Permira and other investors. BioCatch’s platform analyses keystroke timing, touchscreen pressure, swipe patterns, and device handling to distinguish real users from scammers and bots. The company currently protects 760 million users across roughly 350 banks. Visa processes over 329 billion transactions annually worth more than $17 trillion.

Visa estimates that scams and account takeovers cost the global economy more than $1 trillion annually, and generative AI is making attacks cheaper and more convincing. “BioCatch will help our clients stop fraud before it reaches the point of payment,” said Andrew Torre, Visa’s president of value-added services. The acquisition expands Visa’s value-added services division, which sells fraud prevention, cybersecurity, and analytics software and has become one of the company’s fastest-growing businesses.

BioCatch acknowledged the scale of the problem in a blog post: “As a society and industry, we are not winning this fight. The value of fraud and scam losses and the number of fraud and scam attempts, mule accounts, and victims of these financial crimes all continue to grow, in some cases exponentially, every year.” Deepfake-enabled fraud has risen 3,000% since 2023, and behavioral biometrics, which verify identity by how someone interacts with a device rather than what they know or possess, is one of the few defences that scales against AI-generated attacks.

The deal is expected to close by the end of Visa’s fiscal second quarter in 2027, subject to regulatory approvals. Straiker raised $64M for agentic AI security, and the broader security market is consolidating around the premise that AI-powered offence requires AI-powered defence. Visa’s $2.4 billion is the largest bet yet that fraud prevention belongs inside the payment rail, not beside it.

content_html_zh:
TL;DR

Visa 将以 2.4B 美元现金从 Permira 手中收购 BioCatch。 BioCatch 使用行为生物识别技术在付款前发现欺诈行为。 Visa 估计全球每年的诈骗成本为 1T 美元。 7.6 亿用户，350 家银行。

Visa 正以 24 亿美元现金从私募股权公司 Permira 和其他投资者手中收购特拉维夫欺诈检测初创公司 BioCatch。 BioCatch 的平台分析击键时间、触摸屏压力、滑动模式和设备操作，以区分真实用户与诈骗者和机器人。 该公司目前为大约 350 家银行的 7.6 亿用户提供保护。 Visa 每年处理超过 3,290 亿笔交易，价值超过 17 万亿美元。

Visa 估计，诈骗和账户接管每年给全球经济造成超过 1 万亿美元的损失，而生成式 AI 正在使攻击变得更便宜、更令人信服。 Visa 增值服务总裁安德鲁·托雷 (Andrew Torre) 表示：“BioCatch 将帮助我们的客户在付款之前阻止欺诈行为。” 此次收购扩大了 Visa 的增值服务部门，该部门销售欺诈预防、网络安全和分析软件，并已成为该公司增长最快的业务之一。

BioCatch 在一篇博文中承认了问题的严重性：“作为一个社会和行业，我们没有赢得这场战斗。 欺诈和诈骗损失的价值以及欺诈和诈骗企图、骡子账户以及这些金融犯罪受害者的数量每年都在持续增长，在某些情况下呈指数增长。” 自 2023 年以来，基于 Deepfake 的欺诈行为增加了 3,000%，而行为生物识别技术通过某人与设备的交互方式而不是他们所知道或拥有的内容来验证身份，是少数能够抵御人工智能生成的攻击的防御措施之一。

该交易预计将在 2027 年 Visa 第二财季结束前完成，但须获得监管部门的批准。 Straiker 为代理人工智能安全筹集了 6400 万美元，更广泛的安全市场正在围绕人工智能驱动的进攻需要人工智能驱动的防御这一前提进行整合。 Visa 的 24 亿美元是迄今为止最大的赌注，因为欺诈预防属于支付轨道内部，而不是旁边。
